1 . The petition is for quashing of the Fir and charge sheet in C.R.No.221 of 2020 punishable under
Section 420, 406, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
2.

The case of the prosecution is that Respondent No.2 on being promised by the Petitioner and her
husband of delivery of property accepted an amount of Rs.1,00,00,000/- (Rs. One Crore only) in
cash, out of which 50% was returned, however, the balance 50% of the amount is neither paid nor
the property was delivered, as promised.
3 .  The case of the Petitioner is based on the genesis that the amount was paid in case.

Certain matrimonial disputes between the Petitioner and her husband are sought to be relied on so as to infer the liability against the Petitioner, however, such proceedings i.e. in the form of settlement Raji Malvinder Thind/Singh vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146612456/

5. In response to the above submissions, the Counsel for Respondent No.2 submits that time of two weeks' be granted to file reply and to substantiate the claim put-forth in the FIR.
6. We grant three weeks time to Respondent No.2 to file reply in the matter.
7. In view of the above, we deem it appropriate to adjourn the matter to 25th July 2023.
